item.title: No Degree, No Problem: 75 Great Careers Without College
item.description: College is not for everyone, but earning a great living can be. So often, parents and teens fall prey to the myth that the only way to get a well-paying job is with a college degree, and nothing could be further from the truth. Pursuing a career as a plumber may be a good option for teens to explore.

item.title: What Happened When I Let My Son Quit Team Sports
item.description: My son used to play every team sport he could. We were constantly running from activity to activity, and he loved it. He wasn't afraid to try and do things, even if he wasn't very good at it — he just wanted to have fun and would get out there and do his best.

item.title: The Challenges of Parenting Teens: Finding the Right Words and Balance
item.description: Tonight my heart was crushed as my 17-year old daughter confessed to me she had cried not once but twice to two separate family members while we were together at a family birthday gathering. I was there and I didn’t know it happened until she told me. As a parent, I am often at a loss for words.

item.title: My College Freshman Daughter Called it Quits and I Freaked Out
item.description: I could feel my blood pressure rise and my heart sink with every word that came out of my daughter's mouth. She wanted to drop out of college. A wave of fear followed my shock.

item.title: Safety In Numbers: Why This Close Call is a Lesson for ALL Teens
item.description: I love this page…Grown and Flown. I have been following it for several years, since my oldest was still in high school. He is now 21.

item.title: You Can Be A Good Parent And Have A Troubled Kid
item.description: A few weeks ago, I sat in the high school parking lot yelling at my son. The tears were coming hard and fast. I was filled with hopelessness, rage, and my heart hurt.
